body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder, then list the open actions that are due today or overdue, oldest due date first, with their source conversation. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill，然后列出今天到期或已逾期的待办处理事项，按到期日从早到晚，带来源对话。不要修改任何内容。

label.zh-CN: 看到期或逾期的处理事项

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then create the follow-up action I describe: link it to its source message or reply, set the owner and due date I give, and leave the status open.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill 并遵循其工作流程，然后创建我描述的跟进事项：关联到来源消息或回复，填我给的负责人和到期日，状态留为待办。

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then mark the action I name as done and record the outcome I describe in its result field — write what actually happened, not just the new status. Attach the evidence link if I give one.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill 并遵循其工作流程，然后把我点名的事项标为已完成，并把我描述的结果写进完成结果字段——写清实际发生了什么，不要只改状态。我给了证据链接就一并附上。

label.en: Complete an action with its outcome
label.zh-CN: 完成一条事项并记录结果
